entries.title: A Gmail automation can wait for one sender's mail
entries.body: An automation for "A message arrives" now takes Gmail's own search words, such as a sender. Only new mail that matches sets it off, and Google does the matching, so nothing reads your mail to decide. Before, every new email set it off.

picture.alt: A new automation in Settings → Automation for a message arriving in Google, with Gmail search words naming one sender
